meta.name: apollo-rate-limits
meta.description:
Implement Apollo.io rate limiting and backoff.
Use when handling rate limits, implementing retry logic,
or optimizing API request throughput.
Trigger with phrases like "apollo rate limit", "apollo 429",
"apollo throttling", "apollo backoff", "apollo request limits".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 应对 Apollo 接口限流,自动退避重试防 429
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在对接 Apollo 接口时总被限流拖慢开发
copy.tagline_en: Handle Apollo API rate limits with automatic backoff and retry
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're integrating Apollo.io API and getting throttled too often

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会用一套限流与退避逻辑来处理 Apollo.io API 请求：包含令牌桶限流器、带抖动的指数退避、可控制并发的请求队列、基于优先级的调度，以及速率监控和警报。
howto.when: 当你说到“apollo rate limit”“apollo 429”等触发词，或要求处理限流、实现重试逻辑、优化请求吞吐时触发。

say.text: 我的 Apollo API 请求遇到 429 了，帮我加上退避重试。
say.note: Claude 会生成带指数退避的重试逻辑。

say.text: 为 Apollo 请求写一个带并发控制的限流队列。
say.note: Claude 会实现并发受限的请求队列。

say.text: 优化一下 Apollo 请求的吞吐量，避免触发限流。
say.note: Claude 会检查并应用限流策略来调整请求节奏。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will apply rate limiting and backoff to Apollo.io API requests: a token bucket limiter, exponential backoff with jitter, a concurrency-controlled request queue, priority-based scheduling, and rate limit monitoring/alerts.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention keywords like "apollo rate limit" or "apollo 429", or ask to handle rate limits, implement retry logic, or optimize API request throughput.

say_en.text: My Apollo API request got a 429; add backoff and retry.
say_en.note: Claude will generate retry logic with exponential backoff.

say_en.text: Write a rate-limited queue with concurrency control for Apollo requests.
say_en.note: Claude will implement a concurrency-limited request queue.

say_en.text: Optimize my Apollo request throughput to avoid rate limits.
say_en.note: Claude will review and apply rate limiting to adjust pacing.
